description: This circular walk visits Harpford Woods near the village of Harpford in East Devon. You can start the walk from the parking area at the northern edge of the woods. There's miles of peaceful trails to enjoy with streams, spring bluebells, and a walk along the disused Budleigh Salterton railway line near the centre of the woods. The East Devon Way also runs through the woods. You could pick up the waymarked trail and follow it to Harpford Common. Just to the west of the woods you can pick up the Otter Valley Way and enjoy a pleasant riverside walk.
